tasks.short: Submit artwork to shows or galleries

steps.what: Select artwork appropriate to the actual show or gallery
outputs: artist-selected submission works

steps.what: Read the actual submission requirements, eligibility, requested files and recipient details
inputs: actual show or gallery submission instructions
outputs: artist-checked submission requirements and destination

steps.what: Prepare accurate artwork images and the requested supporting statement for the selected works
outputs: artist-prepared artwork images and supporting statement

steps.what: Assemble and finish checking the exact application, attachments and destination using existing portfolio metadata
inputs: artist-prepared artwork images and supporting statement
outputs: complete checked submission application and attachments for the named destination

steps.what: Submit the exact checked application and attachments to the selected show or gallery
inputs: complete checked submission application and attachments for the named destination
outputs: submitted artwork application and portal receipt

tasks.design: Use reusable artist-authored portfolio fields in {DOCS} and the native application form in {PARTNER_PORTAL}. The artist selects and prepares the work, checks the complete application and destination, then submits that exact version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated title, dimensions and biography entry can distract from adapting a submission to its actual requirements.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reusable fields and portfolio metadata can reduce repeated entry without generating artwork claims.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing the right works and expressing their artistic intent.
tasks.human_edge: Judge fit and represent the work accurately.

ambition.what: Reduce repeated application entry, not automate artistic selection.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: artists submit digital artwork images and supporting details through gallery or show forms; existing portfolio fields can reduce repeated entry.

assumptions: This is a digital application scenario; physical delivery would need its actual handling steps. OTHER is the artist's existing image-editing software. The artist already owns the portfolio metadata; new or changed artwork details are captured in s3.

Use native reusable form fields first. Recipient-specific claims and statements remain artist-authored; no browser agent or unsolicited send. Any payment is outside this no-payment submission scenario and not automated.

Shares are unmeasured provisional scenarios. Gross 7.8 minus 1 metadata upkeep gives 6.8 net. Submission is 1% fully retained; final checking is normal application authoring, not an extra approval baseline.
unknowns: Actual repeated field burden and accepted file formats
research_questions: Which portfolio fields recur unchanged, and can native forms reuse them without stale dimensions or titles?

already_counted.description: Assemble and check the actual submission and destination

incremental.description: Maintain reusable artwork and biography fields

approvals.approved_version: complete application, attachments and destination checked at end of s4; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if fields already reusable; cautious range below provisional 6.8% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Submit artwork or project plans for client approval and incorporate changes

steps.what: Prepare and check the initial artwork or project-plan proof, version and intended client recipient
inputs: actual preliminary or finished artwork or project plan
outputs: complete checked initial proof and recipient

steps.what: Send the checked initial proof to the intended client for review
inputs: complete checked initial proof and recipient
outputs: initial proof delivered to client

steps.what: Review the initial proof and provide actual approval or requested changes
outputs: actual client decision and requested changes

steps.what: Interpret actual client feedback and incorporate the necessary artwork or project-plan changes
inputs: actual client decision and requested changes
actual preliminary or finished artwork or project plan
outputs: artist's revised artwork or project plan

steps.what: Prepare and finish checking the revised proof package, version label and intended recipient
inputs: artist's revised artwork or project plan
actual client decision and requested changes
outputs: complete checked revised proof package and recipient

steps.what: Send the exact checked revised proof to the client for final approval
inputs: complete checked revised proof package and recipient
outputs: revised proof delivered to client

steps.what: Review the revised version and decide whether to approve it or request another explicit revision round
outputs: actual client decision on the revised version

tasks.design: Configure reusable proof export settings in {OTHER}, the existing art tool, and retain explicit version labels in {DOCS}. The artist checks each package before each {EMAIL} send; client decisions occur only after the corresponding proof exists and arrives.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated proof export setup and version packaging can consume attention between creative revisions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native art-tool export presets can reuse format and size settings.
tasks.still_hard: Interpreting client feedback without weakening the artwork.
tasks.human_edge: Choose how to incorporate the requested change.

ambition.what: Reduce repeated proof preparation without assuming client approval.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3; client proof-channel and artwork access checks

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: art tools support export presets; artists and clients still review actual proof versions and requested changes.

assumptions: OTHER is existing drawing or image-editing software. Scenario is one revision round, not an asserted average. Additional actual rounds must repeat authoring, exact-version checking, send and client review.

Native presets first. The artist produces every proof and creative revision; the client produces actual feedback. No automated client decision or invented approval status. Sends are separate and fully retained.

Shares are provisional across all labor. Focal baseline is 70; retained reduction is 3.6, so gross is 5.142857% of focal hours. Subtract 0.8 upkeep for 4.342857 net; customer review earns no focal saving.
unknowns: Actual export setup time, revision rounds and native preset availability
research_questions: Does a preset remove repeated setup without sending a stale or wrong-resolution proof?

already_counted.description: Prepare and check revised proof package

approvals.approved_version: complete initial proof and recipient checked at end of s1; edits void check
complete revised proof and recipient checked at end of s5; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if presets already used; cautious range below provisional 4.34% focal net.

tasks.short: Collaborate with technical experts to build and install creations

steps.what: Review actual creation drawings, site constraints and technical proposals from engineers or mechanics
outputs: artist's reviewed technical issues and artistic requirements

steps.what: Discuss fabrication and installation options with engineers, mechanics and other technical experts
inputs: artist's reviewed technical issues and artistic requirements
outputs: agreed artistic requirements and technical questions or decisions

steps.what: Work with the technical team on the actual build and installation, resolving artistic details against real conditions
inputs: agreed artistic requirements and technical questions or decisions
outputs: artist's resolved build and installation details

steps.what: Update and check the artist's drawing annotations for the actual resolved build and installation details
inputs: artist's resolved build and installation details
outputs: complete checked revised artistic drawing annotations

steps.what: Save the checked drawing revision in the existing shared project store
inputs: complete checked revised artistic drawing annotations
outputs: saved artistic drawing revision

tasks.design: Retain technical collaboration and substantive drawing revisions in {DOCS} and {OTHER}. Existing shared annotations already avoid a duplicate meeting report in this scenario; artistic decisions and actual site work remain with the artist and experts.
tasks.previous_blocker: Fabrication and site constraints require negotiation between artistic intent and technical feasibility.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing drawing tools support shared annotations, but no additional repeatable work reduction is established.
tasks.still_hard: Resolve material, structural and visual tradeoffs in real conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Protect artistic intent while responding to technical evidence.

ambition.what: Retain direct collaboration on the build and installation.

reach.task: Advise on actual fabrication and installation constraints
reach.learn: Which artistic details are essential and which technical options are feasible

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: artists collaborate with technical specialists through drawings, site work and substantive revisions; shared annotations support this without resolving engineering questions.

assumptions: OTHER is existing drawing software. This scenario includes actual artistic drawing revisions, split from discussion and site work, not a newly invented meeting note.

Experts supply technical advice; artist supplies artistic requirements and annotations. Expert engineering labor is not estimated as focal labor. No engineering approval or new instruction send is automated.
Native annotation and shared storage already used. Shares are unmeasured provisional scenarios; all work including the 1% save remains and net saving is zero.
unknowns: Whether local collaboration duplicates drawing changes into another record
research_questions: Observe an actual installation revision and identify any duplicate record beyond the substantive drawing change.

already_counted.description: Revise and check actual artistic drawing annotations

incremental.description: No new system or maintenance work

approvals.approved_version: complete revised artistic annotations checked at end of s4; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Substantive collaboration, site work and drawing revisions remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Create and prepare cartoon-character sketches and model drawings

steps.what: Choose the character intent and actual reference details from memory, live models, products or reference material
inputs: actual authorized reference material or observations
outputs: artist's character specification and selected references

steps.what: Create and assess rough cartoon-character sketches against the intended details and references
inputs: artist's character specification and selected references
outputs: artist-selected rough character sketch with rejected inconsistencies identified

loop.purpose: Propose rough visual alternatives for artist selection
loop.input: Artist's character specification and authorized references
loop.check: Artist checks likeness intent, anatomy, silhouette, reference permissions and consistency; rejects unintended details
loop.stop: At most two variant rounds; draw manually if unsuitable
loop.why_not_simpler: Native drawing presets supply brushes and shapes but do not propose the requested new character form

steps.what: Redraw and refine the chosen character into coherent model drawings with the artist's intended details
inputs: artist-selected rough character sketch with rejected inconsistencies identified
artist's character specification and selected references
outputs: artist-refined coherent character model drawings

steps.what: Prepare and finish checking the sketch and model-drawing files, including character consistency and source metadata
inputs: artist's character specification and selected references
outputs: complete checked character drawing files

steps.what: Save the checked drawing files in the existing art project
outputs: saved character sketch and model drawings

tasks.design: Use a bounded image-draft option within {OTHER}, the artist's existing drawing workflow, only for rough alternatives from the artist's specification. The artist selects, redraws and checks coherent model drawings; generated drafts do not become approved artwork by default.
tasks.previous_blocker: Exploring several rough forms requires drawing alternatives before the artist can judge them.
tasks.enabler_now: Image generation can propose rough visual variants, subject to artist correction and rejection.
tasks.still_hard: Maintain character identity, intentional line work and consistent views.
tasks.human_edge: Create a distinctive character and decide which details belong.

ambition.what: Assist rough exploration while retaining artist-authored model drawings.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-7; artist agreement, reference permissions and tool access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: image generation can propose rough character variants, but consistency and intentional model drawings require artist selection and correction.

assumptions: OTHER is drawing software with an authorized image-draft capability; DOCS holds actual reference material. The artist produces the specification and selects references in s1; no hidden prompt-writing or new capture form.

Native brushes, reusable shapes and drawing presets first; a bounded model is considered only for new rough forms. Artist review and rejected attempts are included in s2. Manual refinement and final preparation remain fully retained.
Shares are unmeasured provisional scenarios. Gross 13.5 minus 2 prompt/reference and tool upkeep gives 11.5 net. Same-system save is 1% fully retained; no publication or client send occurs here.
unknowns: Artist acceptance of generated roughs and whether rejection/redrawing erases any exploration saving
research_questions: Compare actual rough-sketch exploration including rejected variants against the artist's native drawing workflow.

already_counted.description: Specify, assess rough variants and check final model drawings

incremental.description: Maintain reference permissions and draft settings; inspect tool changes

approvals.approved_version: complete character drawing files checked at end of s4; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if variants are unsuitable or already faster manually; cautious range below provisional 11.5% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
